listing.summary: Do you, yes YOU! often find yourself in need of a good flag? Do you wish there were more options? If you answered "yes" to one or more of these questions, then I shall provide!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of new faction flags and emblems.

description:
Vexillographic    Menagerie

Do you, yes YOU! often find yourself in need of a good flag? Do you wish there were more options? If you answered "yes" to one or more of these questions, then I shall provide!

Spoiler

Note: If I ever get around to making a full faction mod, one of these is likely to be the first to go, and will be removed from the download if so. But it's not likely I get that far anyways :P

Now Available: The Path of Ludd. Display your faith and righteousness with a kickass flag, as Ludd clearly intended. Separate from the All-in-One pack* pending a Season Two pack Eventually™

Download here :3

I've set up a server to discuss my mod(s) :3

discordPostHtml:
Hi! I made some things! And you can have them!
Specifically, the things are flags. Made them for various things, but they won't see any use for a good while, so they're on the table.

Forum Post
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=30935.0

aiDescription: Provides a variety of new flags for players to use. Includes a specific flag for the Path of Ludd faction. The collection is offered as an all-in-one pack.

gallery.aiCaption: A flag design featuring a dark background with a central red circle and light blue geometric borders.
A collage of various faction flags, including designs labeled 'Luddic' and 'Socialist Revolu'.
Two flag designs displayed side-by-side: one dark with a red circle and blue borders, the other cream with a central emblem and patterned borders.
A grid of numerous faction flags and emblems with labels such as 'Monarchy', 'Goldbranch', 'Evil', and 'Cybertree'.
